title: 'Men ... man' — to be: am / is / are
can_do: O'zingiz haqida to'g'ri gapirasaniz: Men ... man
why: To be — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan so'zlarning boshiga qo'shilmasi: Men ... man, U ... , Biz ... . O'zbek tilida shu ma'nolarda ham «men ... man» — shu yerda am/is/are — shu yerda kiradi.

points.text: Ingliz tilida to be — am, is, are — shu yerda ishlatiladi: Men ... man — I am ..., U (og'a) ... is, U (ayol) ... she is, Biz ... we are, Siz ... you are,ular ... they are. Har bir gapda bir shaxs bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I am a student. — Men talabaman.
examples.uz: I am a student. — Men talabaman.

examples.en: He is a doctor. — U shifokor.
examples.uz: He is a doctor. — U shifokor.

points.text: To be so'zini bir xil shaklda ishlatish kerak: I am, You are, He/She/It is, We are, They are. O'zbek tilida shu yerda har bir gapda qo'shilmasi: I am ..., U is ..., Biz are ...

examples.en: They are here. — Ular shu yerdalar.
examples.uz: They are here. — Ular shu yerdalar.

points.text: To be ingliz tilida o'zbek tilida shu yerda ishlatiladi: Men ... man — I am ..., U ... is, Biz ... are. Bundan keyin, shu yerda shu yerda shu yerda shu yerda ishlatiladi.

common_errors.right: Men talabaman — I am a student
common_errors.why: To be ishlatilmasak, gap to'liq emas: I student emas, I am a student.

common_errors.wrong: U my brother — U men akam.
common_errors.right: He is my brother — U menga akam.
common_errors.why: He — reklama emas, he — uchinchi shaxs uchun. He is my brother emas, u akmang.
Agree — to be talab qilmaydi, shuning uchun I am agree emas, I agree.
I bilan are emas, am emas.

common_errors.right: He is og'a, she is ayol — o'zi ishlatiladi
common_errors.why: He/she — ingliz tilida uchinchi shaxs — shu yerda ishlatiladi.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md shkalasi.

items.focus: shaxsga mos to be shaklini tanlash: I am, He is, They are
to be bilan gap tuzish: I am ..., She is ..., We are ...
xato yozuvlarni topish: I are, He she, I am agree
o'zingiz haqida 3 gap yozish: ism, yosh, holat
tarjima: «Men talaba» — I am a student (to be bilan), «Men achchiq» — I am hungry

final.task: O'zingiz haqida 3 gap yozing: ism, yosh, hozirgi holat (tired/happy/fine).

skill_task.task: Uchinchi shaxs uchun gapni tinglab, to be shaklini yozing: I am..., He is..., She is... Shundan so'ng ushbu gapda biror shaxs bo'lishi kerak.
